subtitle: PC LAUNCHER
tagline: The PlayStation 2 classic, now on PC.
readyDescription: Build ready. Choose your settings and return to the fight.
missing: Missing files: see the Files tab
gpuDesc: The GPU that renders the game. A dedicated card is much faster.
gpuMissing: The selected graphics card is not visible now (GPU mode may have changed); the system default will be used.
modeDesc: Can be toggled in game with F11.
fullResolution: Fullscreen uses your display's native resolution.
aspectDesc: Shape of the picture and of the window; the camera is only widened with widescreen on.
widescreenDesc: PCSX2's widescreen patch: widens the camera to the sides (Hor+) at the aspect ratio above. Off: the game's original 4:3 picture, with side bars.
stretchDesc: No black bars, but proportions are distorted.
scalingDesc: How the game's image is fitted to your screen. If the render resolution is larger than the screen, it is downsampled by area averaging.
sharpnessDesc: Sharpening strength of the bicubic filter (0 = none).
progressiveDesc: On (default): the game's sharp 480p mode. Off: its interlaced mode with the anti-flicker filter, softer.
internalDesc: Multiple of the native resolution. 2× is recommended; above it the game gets heavy and 4× may make it unplayable.
scaleWarning: At 3× the game no longer holds 60 fps on mid-range cards, and 4×, 5× and 6× are experimental. If the fps drops, go back to 2×.
internalUnstable4x: Experimental · may stall or run slowly in heavy scenes
fallbackSmoothnessDesc: Uses 2× automatically when 3× is selected. Recommended for stable 60 FPS in heavy scenes.
fpsLimitDesc: 60 is the native game rate. 120 and 144 only speed up the window presentation: the game logic stays at 60 Hz, so the game never runs faster.
fpsLimit3xDesc: Fixed at 60 FPS in 3× to prevent GPU presentation stalls.
vsyncDesc: Prevents tearing; locks to the display refresh rate.
vsync3xDesc: Disabled in 3× to prevent the GPU queue from blocking the window.
showFpsDesc: Shows the game and window frame rates in a corner.
noteFps: The game itself produces at most 60 frames: its logic is tied to the PS2's 60 Hz VBlank. Drawing the window at 120 Hz or more shows each new frame sooner and lowers latency. The heaviest scenes are CPU-bound.
note3x: At 3×, FPS presentation is fixed at 60 and VSync is disabled. This prevents the OpenGL GPU queue from blocking the window during heavy scenes. Use the fluency fallback in Graphics to run those scenes at 2×.
elfDesc: The main PS2 program from the disc. Game data is looked up in the same folder.
elfInvalid: This file is not God of War NTSC-U (CRC %1)
errorElfMismatch: ELF does not match this build.
isoDesc: Optional. If empty, the .iso in the game folder is used.
extractedIso: Extracted game files will be used
isoMissing: No disc image or extracted game files found
chosenIsoMissing: The selected ISO was not found
memoryDesc: Folder where saved games are kept.
cancelAnimationsDesc: Cuts the end of a roll short with an attack or block and briefly remembers missed attack presses. Cancelling attacks with block and evade is already in the game.
escQuitsDesc: When off, quit by closing the window.
cheatsNotice: During the game, F2 opens the cheat menu and toggles cheats instantly. The ones here are active when the game starts.
cheatsShortcut: Gamepad shortcut for the cheat menu
cheatsShortcutDesc: F2 always works. Capture one button or hold two buttons together; either opens the in-game extras menu.
cheatsShortcutCapturing: Release the pad, then press one button or two together…
cheatsShortcutUnavailable: Gamepad capture is only available on Windows right now.
cheatsShortcutFailed: No supported gamepad button was captured.
cheat_god_modeDesc: Kratos takes no damage; health stays full.
cheat_one_hit_killDesc: Enemies and bosses die in a single hit.
cheat_infinite_rageDesc: Rage meter always full; never runs out while active.
cheat_all_upgradesDesc: Blades of Chaos level 5; magic and Blade of Artemis level 3.
cheat_all_powersDesc: Zeus's Fury, Medusa's Gaze, Poseidon's Rage, Army of Hades, Blade of Artemis and Poseidon's Trident.
cheat_max_metersDesc: Every Gorgon Eye and Phoenix Feather upgrade.
cheat_unlock_extrasDesc: God Mode difficulty, costumes, videos and Challenge of the Gods. Permanent once you save.
keyboardDesc: Click a key, then press the new key or click a mouse button. Right-click clears it. Each action can have two keys.
padSchemeDesc: PS2 layout by default; modern layout is optional.
padButtonDesc: PS2 button sent to the game; an existing assignment is swapped automatically.
captureDesc: Press a key or click a mouse button for %1. Cancel: Esc
conflict: This key is also used by: %1
reservedNotice: This key is used in game for fullscreen (F11), the cheat menu (F2) or the developer panel (F1).
skipVideosDesc: Skips the game's pre-rendered videos (e.g. the intro).
fastBootDesc: Cuts the intro animation short; the opening scene and lines may be cut. Not recommended.
minimizeOnPlayDesc: It comes back when the game closes.
shortcutsDesc: Open the launcher from the app menu or the desktop.
logDesc: Check this file if something goes wrong.
resetDesc: Resets graphics and performance settings; file paths are kept.
aboutText: God of War is a trademark of Sony Interactive Entertainment. This port contains no game files; you need your own copy.
errorExecutable: The port runner is missing or not executable.
errorElf: The game executable (SCUS_973.99) was not found.
raSummary: Enables RetroAchievements. The ISO is optional: without it, the game is identified from the original SCUS_973.99 executable.
raEnabledDesc: Signs in and loads the achievement set when the game starts.
raPasswordDesc: Save only stores the password in the Windows Credential Manager. Sign-in happens when the game starts.
raPasswordSaved: Password saved in the Windows Credential Manager. Sign-in happens when the game starts.
raHardcoreDesc: Cheats are disabled. Required for hardcore achievements.
raNotificationsDesc: Shows a notification in the game when an achievement is unlocked.
raIsoDesc: Neither the ISO nor the SCUS_973.99 in this install is the original (modified or translated): RetroAchievements will not recognize the game.
raIsoOk: The game is identified by the original ISO's hash.
raIsoElf: The original SCUS_973.99 is used to identify the game.
optimizationEnabledDesc: Recompiles the game with the new parts you reach, so it keeps getting faster. The data stays on your PC.
optimizeDuringGameDesc: Turns rebuilding on with the game open. It competes for the CPU and freezes the picture for tens of seconds; off (the default), it only runs after you close the game.
optimizeDuringGameWarning: The rebuild uses every core: with the game open it stops receiving frames and the picture freezes. Turn it on only when debugging.
wizStep1Title: Choose your God of War ISO
wizStep1Text: The installer looks for your original God of War (USA, SCUS-97399) ISO on this PC. If it does not find it, drop the file here or click Browse. The ISO's hash is verified: translated, patched or other-region ISOs will not work. Nothing leaves your computer.
wizSearchingHint: This takes a few seconds. You can also drop the file here.
wizDragHint: or click Browse to choose it.
wizIsoFound: Found automatically · original ISO verified (USA, SCUS-97399).
wizStep2Hint: This folder holds the extracted game files and the compiled build. The ISO is not needed afterwards.
wizRamLimit4: Limit the installer to 4 GB of RAM
wizRamLimit4Desc: Recommended. Keeps the VU1 optimization and compiler concurrency conservative.
wizRamLimit8: Limit the installer to 8 GB of RAM
wizRamLimit8Desc: Uses a larger VU1 optimization set while still leaving headroom for Windows.
wizSummaryText: Everything is set. Review and click Install; the rest happens on its own.
wizSummaryTimeVal: from 30 minutes to a few hours, depending on your PC
wizConfirmCancel: Cancel the installation? What was already done is kept, so you can resume later.
wizErrorHint: Try again: the finished steps are skipped. The installation log has the full details.
wizIsoUnreadable: The file could not be read.
wizIsoFormat: This does not look like a PS2 DVD ISO (2048 bytes per sector).
wizIsoOtherGame: This ISO is not God of War (USA, SCUS-97399).
wizIsoNoExe: The game executable was not found in the ISO.
wizIsoModified: This ISO is modified or a different edition (hash %1). The original USA ISO, without translation or patches, is required.
wizStep2Text: Choose the folder for the extracted game files and the recompiled build. Use a path without accents.
wizDestinationCharacters: The path cannot contain accents or special characters.
wizDestinationSpace: Not enough space: %1 GB free; at least 30 GB are needed.
wizComponentsDesc: Tick what the installer should download. All of these are required to compile the game.
wizComponentsOk: All the required components are already installed.
wizCompVsDesc: Microsoft's C++ compiler. Downloaded from Microsoft under its license; Windows asks for administrator permission and it takes 15 to 30 minutes.
wizCompVsOldDesc: This PC has Visual Studio, but no CMake that can build the game (3.21 or newer): the one bundled with an old Visual Studio is too old. Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools is installed next to it, and your current one is not removed. Downloaded from Microsoft under its license; Windows asks for administrator permission and it takes 15 to 30 minutes.
wizCompGitDesc: Downloads the project libraries (raylib, imgui...). Stays inside the install folder; nothing is installed in Windows.
wizNoInstaller: The installer script (install.ps1 on Windows, install.sh on Linux) was not found next to the repository. Run the launcher from the project folder.
wizLinuxMissingDesc: The build needs programs and libraries that this system does not have yet. The launcher cannot install them for you because that needs your password: run the command below in a terminal, then press Check again.
wizLinuxUnknown: This distribution is not recognized, so there is no command to offer. Install the equivalents of cmake, ninja, a C++ compiler, git, pkg-config and the development files of GL, X11, Xrandr, Xinerama, Xcursor, Xi, xkbcommon, Wayland and ALSA, then press Check again.
wizCompilingText: This will take a while (from tens of minutes to a few hours, depending on your PC). You can leave the launcher open; do not turn the computer off.
wizOptimizationNotice: During the optimization step the game opens by itself for a few minutes: do not touch the keyboard or controller.
wizCancelled: Installation canceled. You can compile again; finished steps are skipped.
wizSuccessText: The game was compiled successfully. Click OK to go to the launcher.
wizErrorText: The installation stopped with an error:
raHardcoreCheatsNotice: RetroAchievements Hardcore is on: cheats are not sent to the game.
customTexturesDesc: Draws the texture replacements you put in the textures folder (PCSX2 format: .png or .dds files named by hash). Takes effect the next time the game starts.
texturesFolderDesc: Opens the textures folder of the installation. Put the pack inside its "replacements" folder, as in PCSX2.
texturesNeedGame: Choose the game files first: the textures folder is created next to them.
texturePackNeedsGame: Install the game first: the texture pack is installed inside its folder.
texturePackDesc: Downloads the community pack (%1 GB) and replaces everything in textures/replacements with it. The folder you have now is only swapped once the pack is fully extracted, so a failed install keeps it, and the ZIP is deleted afterwards. The card disappears once the pack is installed.
texturePackBusy: Installing the texture pack. This takes several minutes: keep this tab and the launcher open until it finishes.
texturePackLocked: The texture pack is being installed. Wait until it finishes before leaving this tab.
texturePackCloseTitle: The texture pack is still installing
texturePackCloseText: If you close the launcher now, the download is lost and has to start again. The textures you have now are not touched. Close anyway?
texturePackFailed: The texture pack could not be installed
asyncTexturesDesc: Reads the replacements in the background and draws the game's own texture until each one is ready, spreading the work on the GPU so the game does not stutter. Off waits for every file (each new texture may pause the game briefly).
updateInstalling: Installing the update, the launcher will restart
updatePortableNote: This portable copy cannot update itself: download the new zip from the release page.
updateManualNote: Download it from the release page.
updateBlocked_optimizer: Wait for the optimization to finish.
updateBlocked_texturePack: Wait for the texture pack to install.
autoUpdateDesc: Checks for a new version of the launcher at start-up and installs it by itself when the game, the installer and the optimization are idle, then restarts the launcher. Off: you only see a notice and press Update. A portable copy only shows the notice.
